\whitespace trim

\define body(will-delete-title)
    <div style="padding:0 15px"> 
        ''insert card''<br/>

        <$edit-text placeholder="Credit card number" tag="input" tiddler="""$will-delete-title$""" field="card" default="" focus="true"/>
        <br/>
        <$edit-text placeholder="Expiration date" tag="input" tiddler="""$will-delete-title$""" field="date" default="" focus="true"/>
        <br/>
        <$edit-text placeholder="CVC" tag="input" tiddler="""$will-delete-title$""" field="cvc" default="" focus="true"/>
        <br/>
        <$button style="width: auto; display: inline-block;">
            <$let card={{$will-delete-title$!!card}} date={{$will-delete-title$!!date}} cvc={{$will-delete-title$!!cvc}}>
                <$action-sendmessage
                    $message="tm-edit-text-operation"
                    $param="insert-text"
                    text={{{ [<card>addprefix[<$credit-card-render card="]addsuffix[" date="]addsuffix<date>addsuffix[" cvc="]addsuffix<cvc>addsuffix["/>]] }}}
                />
            </$let>
            <$action-deletetiddler $tiddler=<<will-delete-title>>/>
            Insert
        </$button>
    </div>
\end body

<$transclude $variable="body" will-delete-title=<<dropdown-state>> />
